approval: Human review ① 2026-10-25 approved the US-14 module card R3 (docs/us/us14-templates-demos-release.md, sha256 ff6594655edc6f669488d744587d14b6d624c994c9bb2b47b2e58e068d284cc6, 2289 lines; review ① accepted R2 design, J-01/J-02/J-04-J-09 and Q-01-Q-22 recommendations, and froze D-01-D-10 under the corrected state rules) and registration; spec.md sha256 a2559dd6a442bed268429bf04d07b3e5f5212b590f73a3410174ab87379a3e14, plan.md sha256 50f33cc232b24613eabe9c2fbae6bab7cd908c804fbca9e3c6bf343d97d0ec75, tasks.md sha256 8cd3fb7ab11e1633ce2116805eaa292d4a01fd54c5dff9aef3e9597b1e9212ea at task freeze; the pre-implement analyze pass (2026-10-25) then corrected only derived task wording and added the key-regression anchors fixed by module card §4.5 (TestMCPCatalog_ReadOnly, TestMCPDiagnostics_DoesNotStartProcess, TestMCPTest_NoOperationOnPrewriteFailure, TestMCPTest_EmptyToolList, TestNotifyMode_DeliverToRemovesNotify, TestRegistry_DuplicateSemanticsUnchanged, TestDocsReadOnly_*), with no scope, contract or assertion change; tasks.md was re-frozen at sha256 786eb5c87c45767044005d1493df7bd3ad205f570f90edaac99c13bbb2c62a1b (70 tasks T001-T070, 0 checked). Stage derived by module-dev step 6.1 as a provisional, loadable red-state baseline: protect lists only paths that already exist; the new Go/Python/console/website files are added at T065 and closeout because loadStage Lstat requires every protected path to exist. checks split the module card §4.3 and §3.8 families without weakening them: e2e runs make e2e and carries level=process so the acceptance runner extracts the single binary_sha256 marker of the distributed candidate; e2e-required runs the same package with -json under the temp-binary fallback so the §4.3 required_tests list can be enforced by name (a direct go test without BASALT_E2E_BINARY is functional-only and never release evidence, module card §6.11 row 7); mcp-connect and notify-exclusion are additive anchors for the §4.5.6 tool-level ConnectDetailed family and the §4.5.9 deliver_to/notify exclusion, because the §3.8 suggested check set names no anchor for them; mcp-admin is the suggested fast-feedback superset. Two baseline checks serve the Phase 1 tasks whose semantic assertions only exist after their test tasks land: go-build compiles the tree for the core-type tasks (T002-T005) and contract-yaml proves the contract document still parses and the pre-existing enums are intact for T001; the new schemas' well-formedness is asserted from T017 on by TestMCPContracts_* via compileObjectSchema, so no assertion is dropped, only deferred to the task that can actually judge it. The suggested example-tests and templates checks are folded into docs-readonly-tests + script-tests and template-quality + make e2e, which run the identical commands, so no assertion surface is removed and no duplicate run is added. script-tests uses the host's py -3 launcher because this Windows machine's python is the Microsoft Store stub; a missing interpreter still fails and is never a skip, and the Makefile keeps PYTHON overridable. required_tests are control-side exact anchors; implementation names must match or the stage is extended additively with a recorded rationale, never weakened. website-test/-build/-check were released from the US-13 review ② gate on 2026-10-25 (see the revision note at the end) and are still not claimed by T058/T059 until they run; every real external service (model, GitHub PAT, Brave, Fetch, Playwright, DBHub, real notification receiver) remains unauthorized, so T060 and the Linux/license/upgrade items stay manual and unverified. This stage is local-only because inputs include the private docs/us module card; it must not enter harness/stages/current.json or CI and grants no approval by itself. Revision 2026-10-25 (user instruction): the US-13 review ② gate on T058/T059 was lifted after the final review ② recorded in US-13 run-state §13.1 and the closeout baseline 24de00e (§13.5); only the stale block markers in tasks.md changed (70 tasks, no renumbering, no assertion change), and tasks.md was re-frozen at sha256 efa371ddbd9723bea597f171e8f253adf5ac396ae03434a01993793bb0a1c8c3 (16 checked; normalized cbe006f34f8ff0fb8e30af061b2709882269d2c10260fef1ed84bec6561a2cad). Lifting the gate is not an opening: T059 still may not touch the SC-011 frozen surface (nine visual files, website/public, website/diagrams), README stays English-only with no new top-level route and no private links, and T060 remains blocked by external authorization. Revision 2026-10-25 (user adjudication, stage self-lock): the acceptance check (make acceptance) was removed because it re-enters the exclusive .loop lock of the very run that invokes it and can never pass inside a stage run (failure ledger #13); T035/T057/T067 now bind docs-consistency, T065 binds stage-lint, T066 binds release-records, T068 binds stage-lint+e2e+clean-checkout and T070 binds stage-lint+release-records. No test, threshold, build tag, -run filter or required_tests entry is removed: every stage-wide run still executes the default full profile plus all stage and task checks (a strict superset of make acceptance), and T068 re-runs e2e and the clean checkout in a committed candidate. tasks.md and its freeze hash are unchanged by this revision. Revision 2026-10-26 (review finding closure, additive only): F1/F2 — the two named checks the module card lists but no test implemented, TestExamples_PortableBaseline and TestMCPEgress_Documentation, were added under internal/e2e (e2e tag) and bound into demo-fixtures and template-quality respectively without removing or relaxing any existing assertion or -run alternative; F5 reordered the deadline check ahead of the *url.Error branch in classifyInitializeFailure with TestClassifyInitializeFailure_DeadlineBeforeURLShell; F6 closed the lstat-to-open window in docs-readonly with os.SameFile (TestDocsReadOnly_RejectsSwappedFile); F3 is recorded as behavior equivalence against TestDeliveryService_DeliverWritesTerminalState / TestDeliveryService_DeliverUnknownIsRecordedNotRetried / TestDeliveryService_SkipKeepsRow; F4 corrected an overclaiming comment in check-release-clean.sh. The URL-credential probe was additionally split out so RFC 2606 documentation hosts (example.com/.net/.org) used by rejection fixtures are not reported as leaks, while any other host still fails (proven by a planted non-placeholder sample); except for that documented false-positive narrowing, which needs explicit user adjudication, every change is additive. No task, threshold or required test was removed. Revision 2026-10-26 (independent re-review closure): the independent re-review found that the template-quality -run pattern ^(TestTemplates_|TestMCPEgress_Documentation)$ anchored TestTemplates_ as a literal and silently executed only TestMCPEgress_Documentation while required_tests still demanded the two TestTemplates_* tests, so the earlier sentence that no -run branch was removed did not hold for that one edit; the pattern is corrected to ^(TestTemplates_.*|TestMCPEgress_Documentation)$ and the branch is verified by -list and -json, amending the earlier sentence. TestDocsReadOnly_RejectsSwappedFile was added to the docs-readonly-tests required_tests. internal/e2e/us14_examples_test.go now judges the AGENT.md baseline structurally (block-style resource_bindings and notify_channels included), scans instance UIDs case-insensitively, checks each SETUP edit item separately and proves each predicate with planted samples; TestMCPEgress_Documentation now judges the Operations 2.2 boundary table row by row (six rows with an expected polarity each) and docs/Operations.md gained the missing remote-MCP-downstream and stdio-launch-program rows required by module card 2.8.3 and C-20; docs-readonly errors return root-relative paths only. Apart from the RFC 2606 URL-credential narrowing recorded in the previous clause (adjudicated by the user on 2026-10-26: accepted as a documented false-positive exemption for example.com / example.net / example.org and their subdomains; credentials on any other host stay fatal), every change is additive.
